body.estimator: paired per-task normalized_reduction difference, with the decision vector reported beside it
body.retention_blocker: assessment_profile.default_repertoire returns the four authored seed ids and e2_replication.eligible_for(task) returns the two belonging to the task's family. Both are closed, frozen and identical for every arm, so a method acquired on one task can never enter another task's repertoire and no difference in method_id can be a retention effect.
body.scored_observable: normalized_reduction, with the decision vector (method_id, max_queries) reported per task

inherited_census_defect.defect: e2_contrast_campaign.reachability_census resolves the default from DEFAULT_METHOD = 'seed-sw-ddmin'. On a graph target that cell does not exist in the row's grid, so `default` is None and the row's positive delta is computed against 0.0 rather than against the real default. The prior census never hit it because its panel was software only.
inherited_census_defect.not_patched: e2_contrast_campaign is frozen and is not edited here. This module computes its own default per family and reports the discrepancy.
inherited_census_defect.reading: where the two disagree the inherited number is the larger, because it measures the gap from nothing rather than from the zero-information default. Both panels in this campaign are graph panels, so every target measured here is one the inherited function misreads.

measureability.note: the terminal verdict is constant by construction, so no claim in this report rests on it. The retained-method leg is unmeasurable on this instrument and is reported as such rather than approximated by a different arm.

retained_method_leg_blocker.mechanism: assessment_profile.default_repertoire returns the four authored seed ids and e2_replication.eligible_for(task) returns the two belonging to the task's family. Both are closed, frozen and identical for every arm, so a method acquired on one task can never enter another task's repertoire and no difference in method_id can be a retention effect.
retained_method_leg_blocker.readable_observable: normalized_reduction, plus the decision vector (method_id, max_queries), which is reported per task and never as the sole benefit metric
retained_method_leg_blocker.what: a policy cannot name a method it retained, so the retained-method-reuse leg has no lever on this instrument
retained_method_leg_blocker.what_this_module_measures_instead: the transfer-shaped leg of retention: a policy shown a retained method's prior observations against the same policy shown none, paired per task, on the panels whose ceiling is open
retained_method_leg_blocker.what_would_be_needed: a repertoire that admits a method acquired on a prior task, and a reducer whose verdict can vary. Neither exists in the frozen instrument, and this campaign edits neither.

measureability.retention_observable: normalized_reduction (paired per task), with the decision vector (method_id, max_queries) reported per task

terminal_verdict_defect.consequence: this campaign reports normalized_reduction and the decision vector instead, and asserts that no claim in the report rests on verdict
terminal_verdict_defect.measured: e2_contrast_campaign.reachability_census records `verdict: preserved` on every cell of every grid it enumerates, and s09_e2_scored's own header says the same: `preserved` is a fixpoint of two composed invariants, not a policy property
terminal_verdict_defect.what: verdict is `preserved` on every reducer outcome, so it cannot vary and cannot carry a retention or adaptation claim

offline_only.what: no dispatch was made. This artifact carries the closure, the defect report and every census, and carries no reading.

qualification_gate.consequence: the retention and adaptation panels must both be on a readable family for a live contrast. This campaign reports the graph panels' censuses, which are valid, and does not run a live contrast on a family the gate cannot read.
qualification_gate.mechanism: all five authored qualification policies in e2_replication hardcode a `seed-sw-` method, and score_response refuses an action naming a method outside the target's family, so on a graph target every one of them is refused before it can act
qualification_gate.reading: the qualification gate is software-only. A panel whose family is outside readable_families cannot be run on this instrument, and a run on it would refuse at the gate rather than report a number. A census on such a panel still holds: the ceiling is a property of the grid and needs no policy.

repertoire_closure.mechanism: assessment_profile.default_repertoire returns the four authored seed ids and e2_replication.eligible_for(task) returns the two belonging to the task's family. Both are closed, frozen and identical for every arm, so a method acquired on one task can never enter another task's repertoire and no difference in method_id can be a retention effect.
repertoire_closure.reading: a retention contrast needs a policy to be able to name a method it retained. Every target here is shown the same two authored seeds and the gate admits exactly those four ids, so no acquired method can arrive. The method_id leg is therefore not measurable here, and the retention leg is measured on normalized_reduction instead.
